judgementOnTheRawPipeTables.answer: YES, it reaches ARTIFACTS. And FIX04 was nonetheless right to decline to repair it. Those are two different questions and both answers stand.
whyItReachesArtifacts: It is on the delivered participant-facing artifact and visible on a 150 dpi raster, not only in extracted text. Confirmed by reading guidance page 1 and page 2 as images.

It disfigures the single most operational section in the packet. 'What you must supply before filing' is the six-row instruction that tells the participant which document, which blank, and what to write in it. That is the section a participant works from with a pen.

The failure is structural, not cosmetic. The only thing carrying the column boundary is a pipe glyph sitting mid-sentence, and the header row that names the three columns is separated from its rows by a blank line and is typographically indistinguishable from a data row. The participant must infer the column semantics from a punctuation mark. On row 3 the result runs on as '...the last four digits of your Social Security number, and only the last four - the full number goes on the Confidential Information Form', where correct content has lost the column that gave it its meaning.

The renderer's own behaviour proves an intent it cannot honour. It parsed the table well enough to delete the '| --- |' rule and not well enough to lay out a column, and it strips the leading and trailing pipe of every row while keeping the interior ones. That is a half-implemented feature shipping to a participant, not an authoring choice - which is exactly what distinguishes it from the heading and emphasis losses, where the renderer at least deletes the marker and leaves clean prose.
ARTIFACTS is a property of the delivered artifact. A repairer's scope does not enter into whether the artifact passes.
judgementOnTheRawPipeTables.whyFix04WasStillRightToDeclineIt: The fix belongs in the shared guidance renderer, and repairing it inside three per-family build scripts would either fork the renderer three ways or under-fix the many other families that carry the same table. FIX04's obligation was the opening block. Recording it and leaving it was the correct disposition of a defect it should not unilaterally widen its blast radius to fix. This lane records it, does not repair it, and does not fault FIX04 for it.
